name: Threat from Below

angles.text: Searching the coast helps defend Durotar and keep the young Horde from being flanked along its shores.
As an orc, you see the ambush on scout Heglan Shadeeye as an intolerable intrusion into your settled homeland. It calls for an immediate investigation and retaliation.
As a Darkspear troll, you know the naga’s treachery well. Your people have faced sea witches and horrors of the Great Sea.

faq.answer: The Horde investigates the ambush on scout Heglan Shadeeye along Durotar’s coast. You search the damaged site for clues to the unknown attackers, then bring what you find to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill so he can judge the danger to the region.

Heglan Shadeeye is a Shattered Hand scout who watched Tiragarde Keep from a hut north of it. An enemy ambushed her at her coastal post while she kept watch, and the wreckage shows she fought fiercely. Razor Hill’s leaders need to know who attacked her.
Naga attacked Heglan Shadeeye along Durotar’s shore. A torn banner and a broken blade fragment found at the site identify the serpent-like attackers, and the fierce fight left them wounded.

Orgnil Soulscar is an orc authority stationed at Razor Hill in central Durotar. He organizes the region’s defense and coordinates Horde scouts. When Heglan Shadeeye fails to report, he relies on returning scouts and travelers to identify the attackers and protect the settlement.

Razor Hill faces human marines from Kul Tiras to the south and hostile quilboar to the west. If naga establish a permanent foothold on the northern coast, the outpost could be caught between its enemies, its small garrison stretched thin, and Durotar’s reinforcement routes cut off.
faq.q: Why are the naga a danger to Razor Hill?

aliases: how did naga get to durotar
faq.answer: The recovered remnants suggest the naga came south along the coast from northern waters, perhaps from Azshara or the Great Sea shelf. They used the waterways to evade inland patrols and strike isolated coastal posts before Durotar’s defenders could organize a perimeter.
faq.q: Where did the attacking naga come from?

sections.body: Heglan Shadeeye’s post on the Durotar coast lies shattered after a fierce skirmish. A Shattered Hand scout, she was keeping watch when an unseen enemy ambushed her. The wreckage shows she fought back and wounded her attackers. With hostile forces moving along the eastern shore, the Horde needs to learn who struck her. You search the campsite and nearby ground for clues.
sections.title: Ambush on the Durotar Coast

sections.body: The wreckage holds a torn banner and a broken piece of an exotic blade, both belonging to the naga. These serpent-like creatures seem to have moved south along the Durotar coast from Azshara. Razor Hill already faces human invaders from Tiragarde Keep to the south and quilboar in the western canyons. A new attack from the north could overwhelm the settlement’s defenses.
sections.title: The Serpent Threat

summary: Along Durotar’s eastern shore, Threat from Below begins with an ambush on scout Heglan Shadeeye. The Horde searches her ruined post for clues to the attackers and what they find puts Razor Hill’s defenses at risk.
